segments.source: Source: This story came from a Welsh pedlar—a woman.
Its genuineness may be relied upon.
I find it a common belief that fairies have power over witches, and the witch-hare is commonly believed in; also a witch-fox.
I have heard of no evil fairies in Wales; all the mischief seems to be the work of witches.
I have heard several variants of the witch-hare.
